attributes.name: Karzoug's Burning Glaive
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to roll your Strength or Melee die + 1d10+2; you may additionally discard this card to add another 1d6+8 with the Fire trait. If you aren't proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4.

Discard this card to attempt an Intelligence or Charisma 8 check. If you succeed, recharge 1d4+1 random cards from your discard pile; if you fail, bury this card.
